shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "pwd && rg --files -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g '"'!package-lock.json'"' -g '"'!pnpm-lock.yaml'"' -g '"'!yarn.lock'"' | head -80"
/bin/bash -lc 'cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md'

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,85p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; rg -n -C 3 'chartkit|yagr|charts' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; cat package.json src/App.tsx src/main.tsx; cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md"

/bin/bash -lc 'ls -a; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md | head -100; cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/icons.md; cat tsconfig.json; npm install @gravity-ui/chartkit @gravity-ui/charts @gravity-ui/yagr @gravity-ui/navigation @gravity-ui/icons'

/bin/bash -lc "cat CLAUDE.md; rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/components | rg '(SegmentedRadioGroup|Select/Select|Button/Button|Modal/Modal|Checkbox/Checkbox|DropdownMenu/DropdownMenu)\\.d.ts"'$'"' ; curl -Ls https://gravity-ui.com/icons -o /tmp/gravity-icons.html; rg -o '\"(Chart[A-Za-z]+|Arrow[A-Za-z]+|[A-Za-z]*Gear[A-Za-z]*|Bell|House|Squares4|Pulse|Calendar|Ellipsis|CircleQuestion|Chevrons[A-Za-z]+|Chevron[A-Za-z]+|ArrowDownToLine|Sliders|Plus|Check|Xmark)\"' /tmp/gravity-icons.html | sort -u | head -65"

/bin/bash -lc "node -e \"for(const n of ['uikit','chartkit','charts','yagr','navigation','icons']) {const p=require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/'+n+'/package.json'); console.log(n,p.version,JSON.stringify(p.peerDependencies))}\"; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/README.md | head -180; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/README.md | head -130; rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit | rg '(SegmentedRadioGroup|Select/Select|Button/Button|Modal/Modal|Checkbox/Checkbox|DropdownMenu/DropdownMenu).*d.ts"'$'"' | head -35"

/bin/bash -lc "ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/docs; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/docs/INDEX.md; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/INDEX.md | head -80; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/README.md | head -110; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/README.md | head -120; node -e \"fetch('https://gravity-ui.com/icons').then(r=>r.text()).then(s=>require('fs').writeFileSync('/tmp/gravity-icons.html',s))\""

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/esm/plugins/{gravity-charts,yagr}/index.js; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/esm/types.d.ts | head -140; rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/esm | head -45; sed -n '1,180p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/components/AsideHeader.md; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroup.d.ts; rg -n 'interface SelectProps|render|options|onUpdate|size|value|className' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Select/types.d.ts | head -40; node -e \"const s=require('fs').readFileSync('/tmp/gravity-icons.html','utf8'); const a=s.match(/.{0,65}(ChartLine|ArrowDownToLine|Gear|Pulse|House|Bell|Layers|CircleQuestion|Calendar|Sliders|ChartColumn|ArrowUpRight|Ellipsis|Database).{0,65}/g); console.log([...new Set(a)].slice(0,45).join('\\n'))\""

/bin/bash -lc "ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build; rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build | head -45; rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist | rg 'types/(chart|series|x-axis|y-axis|axis).*d.ts' | head -30; rg -n -C 3 'CSS|--gn-|renderFooter|renderSubheader|logo|headerDecoration' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/components/AsideHeader.md | tail -100; head -c 500 /tmp/gravity-icons.html; rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr | rg '(types|config).*d.ts' | head -20; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Modal/Modal.d.ts | head -90; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Checkbox/Checkbox.d.ts | head -60"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/plugins/{gravity-charts,yagr}/index.js; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/plugins/{gravity-charts,yagr}/types.d.ts; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/components/ChartKit/ChartKit.d.ts; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/line.d.ts | head -125; rg -n 'type|tick|labels|grid|format|min|max|title|plot' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/axis.d.ts | head -60; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/chart.d.ts | head -100; rg -n 'renderFooter|renderSubheader|logo|className|style' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/types.d.ts; rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons | head -8; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/package.json | head -70; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/plugins/yagr/renderer/Renderer.js | head -110"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/types/{index,widget}.d.ts | head -170; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/components/ChartKit.d.ts | head -140; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/plugins/gravity-charts/renderer/GravityChartsWidget.js | head -70; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/plugins/yagr/renderer/YagrWidget.js | head -110; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/types.d.ts | head -100; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/Logo/Logo.d.ts | head -80; rg -n 'RawSerieData|YagrConfig|timestamp|timeMultiplier|legend|adaptivity' node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/types.d.ts | head -35; rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons | rg '/(Chart|Arrow|Pulse|Gear|Bell|House|Square|Layers|Database|Calendar|Sliders|CircleQuestion|Ellipsis|CircleCheck|Person|Magnifier|Clock|File|Chevron)' | head -65; sed -n '210,310p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/axis.d.ts; rg -n 'interpolation|visible' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/{line,base}.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/plugins/yagr/renderer/useWidgetData.js | head -130; rg -n -C 2 'RawSerieData|timeMultiplier|timestamp|export interface YagrConfig|legend\\??:|adaptivity\\??:|axes\\??:|scales\\??:' node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/YagrCore/types.d.ts | head -130; rg -n 'type LogoProps|interface LogoProps|icon:|icon\\?:' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/types.d.ts | head -25; sed -n '35,85p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/axis.d.ts; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/Button.d.ts | head -65; rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons | rg '/(ArrowDownToLine|ArrowUpRight|ArrowRotateRight|ChartLine|ChartColumn|CircleQuestion|CircleCheck|Calendar|Ellipsis|ChevronsUpDown|ChevronDown|Bell|ArrowRight|Check|Xmark)\\.d.ts'; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/index.js; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/package.json | head -45; rg -n 'export interface ChartData|legend\\??:|tooltip\\??:' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/types/chart.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/types/*.d.ts | head -25"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '175,207p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/YagrCore/types.d.ts; sed -n '260,302p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/YagrCore/types.d.ts; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/YagrCore/plugins/legend/legend.d.ts | head -60; sed -n '90,113p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/types.d.ts; rg -n 'format|style' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/axis.d.ts | tail -20; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/marker.d.ts | head -60; rg -n 'shapeYagrConfig|timeline|timeMultiplier' node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/plugins/yagr/renderer/utils.js | head -25; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Switch/Switch.d.ts | head -50"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '329,347p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/axis.d.ts; rg -n 'interface CommonSeriesOptions|width\\??:|color\\??:|show\\??:' node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/YagrCore/types.d.ts | head -25; rg -n 'export.*Arrow|export.*Chart|export.*Database' node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/index.d.ts | head -30; rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit | rg '/themes/.*css' | head -10; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/DropdownMenu/DropdownMenu.d.ts | head -60"

/bin/bash -lc "node -e \"const fs=require('fs');const p='src/App.tsx';fs.writeFileSync(p,fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8').replace('return <AsideHeader className=', 'return <><AsideHeader className='))\"; npm run build"

/bin/bash -lc "cat vite.config.ts; git status --short; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/AsideHeader.css | head -45; cat index.html; rg -n 'selection|border-radius' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroup.css | head -20"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n 'border-radius|background-color|text-color' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/{Select/Select.css,SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroup.css,Button/Button.css} | head -35; rg -n 'as\\??:' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Text/Text.d.ts; cat .gitignore; sed -n '32,100p' src/data.ts; sed -n '1,55p' src/chartRegistry.ts"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm test && npm run build > /tmp/pulse-build.log 2>&1'
/bin/bash -lc 'tail -1 /tmp/pulse-build.log; git status --short | head -20'
